crossRefs.note: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate…
Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on…
The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

translations.web: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
translations.bsb: Then Tamar got up and departed. And she removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments again.
translations.kjv: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
translations.asv: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
